fields.objection: The last converged pressure of a load-controlled solve is not a validated collapse pressure. Perfect-plastic tangent singularity and numerical cutbacks can stop the path.
fields.proposed_fix: Use a validated continuation/dynamic method, mesh and increment convergence, and a matching physical test before assigning ultimate capacity.
